about: Vyshneve: new builds right next to Kyiv

Vyshneve has practically merged with Kyiv's Borshchahivka and Zhuliany, so the tasks here are the same as in the capital's new builds: a flat from the developer, an open plan and the need to fit a kitchen, living room and nursery into a compact area.

Next to the blocks, old private houses and dachas remain, which owners rebuild for year-round living. Here we often combine an apartment renovation for some family members with a house reconstruction for others.

In Vyshneve apartments the most common request is [apartment design](/en/apartment-interior-design) that turns a studio into separate rooms, or the reverse — joining the kitchen and living room. We make the drawings detailed enough that the crew decides nothing on the spot. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments from screed and plaster to furniture; for new builds see also [new-build renovation](/en/new-build-renovation). Private plots are small, so houses are usually compact, on two floors with a minimum of corridors; [house reconstruction](/en/house-reconstruction) with a second floor added is possible after a survey.

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.

faq: Can the kitchen be joined with the living room in a new build?
It depends on the structure and on whether the flat has gas. We check this at the planning stage, before renovation starts.
How much does renovation in Vyshneve cost?
From $550 per m² for works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are separate, per estimate.
Are prices in Vyshneve different from Kyiv?
No, the base rates are the same: design from $30 per m², renovation from $550 per m², furnishing from $250 per m².
